identification: Three air-velocity meters: (1) British-type rotating-vane anemometer, black-japanned vane ring with gilt-brass bezel, cream dial with centre hand and three subsidiary counter dials, suspension ring, in fitted tan leather case (early-mid 20th century; maker name on dial too small to read at 800x600); (2) Florite vane anemometer/velometer, black crackle-finish housing, 'FLORITE / MADE IN U.S.A.' on grille, side screw post (c.1950s-60s); (3) Sims (Sims Anemometer Co, USA) deflecting-vane direct-reading anemometer, 'Press button for high scales', gold label 'Sims ANEMOMETER 73244', with red plastic stand/holder.
